LanguageData.VaultNoDepositDesc: When enabled, haulers will no longer choose this building as a storage destination (withdraw-only).
LanguageData.VaultNoWithdrawDesc: When enabled, haulers cannot automatically take items, and workbench/food/medicine search is disabled unless "Allow taking for use" is on.
LanguageData.VaultAllowTakeForUse: Allow taking for use while disallowed
LanguageData.VaultAllowTakeForUseDesc: When enabled together with "Disallow withdrawing", workbench ingredients and eating/treatment search still see this building's contents (hauling remains disabled).
